stories.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra, its first model to hit internal security threshold
stories.blurb: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra is out. The company calls it a generational leap for cybersecurity, software engineering, science, and computer use. It's the first model OpenAI says crosses its internal security capability threshold — though they're still releasing it.
stories.why_it_matters: The model powerful enough to trigger OpenAI's own safety bar is now public.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’

stories.headline: Google's weather AI now beats traditional forecasts up to 15 days out
stories.blurb: WeatherNext 3 outperforms existing physics-based weather models across most metrics, from hurricane tracking to precipitation forecasts. It runs faster than older AI models and already powers forecasts in Google Search, Maps, and Flights — plus it's available to researchers and meteorologists worldwide through an open API.
stories.why_it_matters: AI weather models are now accurate enough to replace century-old physics simulations for most real-world decisions.
stories.original_headline: Introducing WeatherNext 3, our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model

stories.headline: Google now lets you talk to Gmail, Docs, and Keep like Gemini Live
stories.blurb: Google is rolling out voice modes for Gmail, Docs, and Keep that work like Gemini Live — you can manage emails, documents, and notes by talking to them in real time. The conversational AI responds as you speak, letting you dictate, search, and organize without typing.
stories.why_it_matters: Voice control moves from chatbot novelty to everyday productivity tools millions already use.
stories.original_headline: Google now lets you chat with Gmail, Docs, and Keep

stories.headline: NVIDIA and Microsoft are shipping AI agents that run on your laptop
stories.blurb: Starting in October, new RTX Spark Windows PCs will run AI agents locally—no cloud required. NVIDIA and Microsoft built tools to make agents easier to set up and faster to run on RTX GPUs, bringing what used to need server farms down to a desktop machine.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agents are moving from the cloud to hardware you can own and control.
stories.original_headline: Sparks Fly: NVIDIA Accelerates Local AI at IFA 2026
